name: capture-aprs
label: APRS capture (headless)
description: Headless 22050 Hz mono WAV capture for offline APRS / packet diagnosis. Tunes 144.39 MHz, channelises to 50 kHz, NBFM-demods, resamples to multimon's native 22050 Hz, writes to /tmp/ferrite-aprs.wav. Run via `ferrited --flowgraph capture-aprs.json --source-type SoapySource --source-args 'driver=sdrplay' --source-antenna 'Antenna A' --source-gain 53 --agc true --run-for-secs 60 --start`, then feed the wav to `multimon-ng -t wav -a AFSK1200 /tmp/ferrite-aprs.wav` to compare.
